semantics.nested_packs: Default benchmark sizes. S is contained in M; M is contained in L.
semantics.large_first: New roles enter L first and do not silently increase every S/M run.
semantics.scenario_sets: Exact requester/participant closure for selected tasks; no unrelated agents are loaded.
semantics.custom_sets: Use scripts/select_agent_set.py to union any scenarios and task IDs.
semantics.task_pack: The smallest default nested pack containing all principals; scenario/custom sets may select the same task without loading the rest of that pack.

profiles.description_en: Engineering, product, deploy, support reliability, and customer incidents without loading unrelated healthcare governance or private-life roles.
profiles.description_zh: 覆盖工程、产品、部署、支持可靠性和客户事件，不加载无关医疗治理或私人角色。

profiles.description_en: Vendor security, vulnerability lifecycle, audit, data release, and identity/access governance.
profiles.description_zh: 覆盖供应商安全、漏洞生命周期、审计、数据发布和身份/访问治理。

profiles.description_en: Cross-organisation contracting, BAA, subprocessor, purchasing, and vendor-release workflows.
profiles.description_zh: 覆盖跨组织合同、BAA、subprocessor、采购及 vendor 放行流程。

profiles.description_en: Hiring, onboarding, role changes, offboarding, benefits, and leave administration.
profiles.description_zh: 覆盖招聘、入职、岗位变更、离职、福利和休假管理。

profiles.description_en: Month-end, payment, board, investors, and controlled public publishing.
profiles.description_zh: 覆盖月度关账、付款、董事会、投资人和受控对外发布。

profiles.label_zh: 临床安全与 EHR 变更
profiles.description_en: Clinical governance, patient safety, EHR integration, medication and results safety, payer authorisation, formal grievances, medical-staff governance, and post-release clinical-AI monitoring without the full corporate and personal network.
profiles.description_zh: 覆盖临床治理、患者安全、EHR 集成、用药与结果安全、支付方授权、正式申诉、医务人员治理和临床 AI 上线后监测，不加载完整公司与私人网络。

profiles.description_en: Patient safety, clinical governance, EHR integration, and clinical-AI monitoring without grievance, credentialing, payer, medication, or results modules.
profiles.description_zh: 覆盖患者安全、临床治理、EHR 集成和临床 AI 监测，不加载申诉、资质、支付方、用药或结果模块。

profiles.label_zh: 患者权利与医务人员治理
profiles.description_en: Formal grievance and medical-staff credentialing/privileging governance as a compact specialist set.
profiles.description_zh: 以紧凑专业集合覆盖正式患者申诉及医务人员资质/privileging 治理。

profiles.label_zh: 用药、结果与支付方运营
profiles.description_en: Medication recall/shortage, electronic results-routing, and payer-authorisation operations without the full clinical profile.
profiles.description_zh: 覆盖药品召回/短缺、电子结果路由和支付方授权运营，不加载完整临床 profile。

profiles.description_en: Health-information requests, record amendments, proxy access, data release, and privacy incidents.
profiles.description_zh: 覆盖健康信息请求、病历更正、proxy access、数据发布和隐私事件。

profiles.description_en: Emergency preparedness, IT fallback, managed IT, and support/reliability incidents.
profiles.description_zh: 覆盖应急准备、IT fallback、外包 IT 和支持/可靠性事件。

profiles.description_en: Approved operational, patient, workforce, and media messages with privacy and clinical boundaries.
profiles.description_zh: 覆盖受批准的运营、患者、员工及媒体消息，并保留隐私和临床边界。

profiles.description_en: Family, partner, therapist, GP, and trainer tasks only; company agents appear only when a declared personal task needs them.
profiles.description_zh: 仅覆盖家人、伴侣、治疗师、家庭医生和教练任务；只有任务明确需要时才包含公司角色。

promotion_options.label_zh: 精简 Small 运营晋升
promotion_options.reason_en: Adds recurring IAM, support/reliability, and PEO workflows that can run with the original Small principals.
promotion_options.reason_zh: 补充可与原 Small 角色共同运行的 IAM、支持/可靠性和 PEO 高频流程。

promotion_options.reason_en: Adds incident/patient communications to the lean operational Small option.
promotion_options.reason_zh: 在精简 Small 运营方案上增加事件/患者传播。

promotion_options.reason_en: Recreates the broader 51-agent Medium only if repeated experiments require records, continuity, patient safety, communications, IAM, reliability, and PEO together.
promotion_options.reason_zh: 只有在重复实验确实需要病历、连续性、患者安全、传播、IAM、可靠性和 PEO 同时存在时，才恢复较大的 51 人 Medium。
